fields.description: Golf Lane is a villa neighbourhood at Emaar South, offering four-bedroom semi-detached homes and five-bedroom standalone homes. Six named layouts provide different internal arrangements across ground, first and second floors, with balconies, patios and roof terraces overlooking the surrounding community.
amenities: Golf course and clubhouse within Emaar South

overview: The brochure emphasises contemporary façades, warm interiors and substantial outdoor terraces. Shared facilities sit within the wider Emaar South golf community, which also includes a community park, retail kiosks, a skate park, a multipurpose court and events space. These are neighbourhood features, not assurances that every home has a golf view or that golf membership is included.
research.locationNote: Golf Lane is in Emaar South, within Dubai South, with highway connections towards Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai. Check the selected home’s access and outlook against its plot plan, and test regular commuting routes at the times you expect to travel.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises AED 4.48m. The May 2024 launch sheet lists four-bedroom villas from AED 4.48m and five-bedroom villas from AED 5.36m. These category starts are historical reference points; they are not confirmation of currently available units.
research.paymentNote: The launch plan requires 10% on booking, 70% in seven later instalments and 20% at estimated completion. Property Finder reports the same 10/70/20 split. Current unit and resale terms need separate confirmation.
research.handoverNote: The launch payment PDF estimates October 2028 completion, consistent with Property Finder. Q4 2028 remains an estimated delivery period rather than a guarantee.

facts.label: Published development scale
facts.value: Emaar describes 664 villas. This is the development count, not the number currently available.

facts.label: Area definition
facts.value: Totals include suite, garage and balcony/terrace areas; they are not plot sizes. Original and mirrored totals match except for Sage, which is listed separately above.

facts.label: Ava layout example
facts.value: A ground-floor guest bedroom and maid’s room sit below three bedrooms. A second-floor flex room, bathroom and terrace provide additional space without changing the four-bedroom classification.

facts.label: Myra layout example
facts.value: One bedroom is on the ground floor, three on the first and one on the second. Plans also mark a lift, maid’s room, laundry, storage and garage; confirm delivered specifications in the contract.
